For the outbound route, Oman would clear ships for exit after notifying Iran. The plan would give Iran visibility over outbound traffic in the Strait, with the possibility to intervene if necessary. The senior Iranian source added that Tehran was unlikely to accept any other alternative to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
